svg.title: Client onboarding flow — signup to live AI agent
svg.desc: Step-by-step flow showing how a new client goes from visiting the platform to having a live AI receptionist agent.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should the landing page show to convert visitors?')
g.text: Sees pricing, demo video, "Start free trial" CTA

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What fields should the signup form have?')
g.text: Sign up with email + password (or Google)
Name · Business name · Email · Password · Business type

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should the pricing page look during onboarding?')
g.text: Stripe checkout — card details entered · 2-week trial starts free

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What business info should I collect in onboarding step 1?')
g.text: Business hours · timezone · emergency contact number

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does calendar OAuth connect work in onboarding?')
g.text: Click "Connect Cal.com" or "Connect Calendly" → OAuth popup
System fetches available slots · confirms connection ✓

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the AI greeting script auto-generated?')
g.text: Add custom FAQs: insurance, parking, wait times, pricing
Choose AI voice (Azure TTS: female/male, accent)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the Twilio number provisioned automatically?')
g.text: System auto-provisions a US local number via Twilio API
Client sees their number: e.g. +1 (512) 800-XXXX · copy to share

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the browser-based test call work?')
g.text: Talk to your AI before going live
Browser-based test call (Twilio JS SDK) — no phone needed
Client hears the agent, tests booking, adjusts script if needed

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens when the client clicks Go Live?')
g.text: Twilio webhook pointed to platform · agent starts answering calls immediately

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should the client dashboard show after going live?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through exactly what happens when a patient calls the clinic')
sendPrompt('How do I upsell clients to higher plans?')
g.text: Dashboard nudges upsell at right time
"You hit 280/300 calls this month → upgrade to Pro for unlimited" · or add review collection / outbound

svg.text: Legend — click any step for details
